question: A regular hexagon has a perimeter of 72 cm. What is its area?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of regular hexagon (a) = Perimeter ÷ 6 = 72 ÷ 6 = 12 cm.

Area of regular hexagon = 3√3 ÷ 2 × a²

⇒ Area = 1.5 × 1.732 × (12)²

⇒ Area = 2.598 × 144 = 374.112 ≈ 374.12 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 374.12 cm².**
